description: Shared shoe product profile schema for user image recognition, catalog tagging, candidate verification, and conversation context.

confidencePolicy.rule: Use null when a field cannot be identified reliably. Do not invent brand, model line, or colorway.

brand.description: Normalized brand name, for example Nike, Adidas, Puma, Anta, Li-Ning.

modelLine.description: Stable model line without marketing noise, for example Air Zoom Pegasus.

colorFamily.description: Controlled color family joined by underscore.

colorway.description: Commercial colorway when visible, for example Black White.

size.description: Visible or user-provided shoe size. Usually null from image only.

styleTags.description: Visual style tags such as low_top, knit_upper, chunky_sole.

sceneTags.description: Use scenes such as running, casual, commute, training.

keywords.description: Search keywords derived from stable fields.
